insights: The market shows a clear upward trajectory, with the current 7-day average (1514) significantly outperforming the 30-day average (1459), indicating accelerating hiring momentum.
FAANG+ companies are aggressively expanding their new graduate headcount, acting as the primary engine for recent growth despite stagnation in the unicorn segment.
While specialized roles like Data/ML remain resilient, hardware and generalist roles are experiencing cooling, suggesting a shift toward high-leverage software and AI-centric talent acquisition.
